flavor:
Retinue Men-at-Arms
Common steppe riders possess a lifetime of skill: these veteran horsemen, yet more. To stand against them is pain; to chase after them is death.
name: Retinue Horse Archers

flavor: The ranks of the Asawira are composed of Iranian nobles skilled with both lance and bow. Now restored as a military force, they stand ready to assail the enemies of Persia.
name: Asawira

flavor: Forced to defend themselves from stronger threats, Emishi horse archers are masters of hit-and-run tactics, raiding, and ambushes.
name: Emishi Riders

requirements.detail: Can recruit Emishi Riders as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Armored riders carrying strong bows. As each leads a string of fine horses, these nomads can fight tirelessly on the open field.
name: Heavy Horse Archers

flavor: Horse archers are used by nomadic tribes to unleash hails of arrows while being almost impossible to catch.
name: Horse Archers

requirements.detail: Can recruit Horse Archers as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Adopting the techniques of the northern Emishi but using heavier armor, samurai take to the saddle, yumi in hand, and harry their foes with arrows.
name: Mounted Samurai

requirements.detail: Can recruit Mounted Samurai as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: The elite guard of a nomadic ruler, the Kheshig guarantee the safety of their liege, day and night. The khorchin, their battle division, extends this guard onto the field of battle.
name: Kheshig

flavor: Brave volunteer riders — 'those already dead' — are the very first to crash into the enemy and, by their ruin, draw the foe into reckless disorder.
name: Mangudai

requirements.detail: Can recruit Mangudai as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor:
Retinue Men-at-Arms
These elite archers are no rabble of poachers: they are relentlessly drilled to rain arrows accurately and at great speed.
name: Retinue Archers

flavor:
Retinue Men-at-Arms
Knight or knave: any can be pierced through by the carefully-placed iron bolts of these highly-trained crossbow-wielders.
name: Retinue Crossbowmen

flavor: For thousands of years the Nubians have protected their homeland by mastering the bow from a young age, fighting off the raids from surrounding desert peoples and invaders alike.
name: Nile Archers

requirements.detail: Can recruit Nile Archers as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Spear-sized bolts soar from these torsion-based machines into besieged settlements and enemy formations alike, causing fear and disorder.
name: Ballistrai

requirements.detail: Can recruit Ballistrai as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Professional archers fill the air with arrows, devastating the foremost enemy troops.
name: Bowmen

flavor: These West African archers turn the difficult terrain of the bush to their advantage.
name: Bush Hunters

requirements.detail: Can recruit Bush Hunters as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Though slow to reload, crossbows are easy to use and fire bolts which can pierce through most armor at a good range.
name: Crossbowmen

flavor: Equipped with powerful reflex bows and thumb rings to strengthen their draw, these archers can fire arrows over an incredible range.
name: Gakgung Archers

requirements.detail: Can recruit Gakgung Archers as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Though they require a lifetime to properly master, the longbows of England and Wales are powerful enough to pierce plate and can loose volleys at an almost-unequaled rate.
name: Longbowmen

requirements.detail: Can recruit Longbowmen as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Scum of the earth, these men have forsaken lawfulness for a life of crime.
name: Poachers

flavor: These war-princes are the defenders of the cold taiga, and fight well where horses and raiding-parties can scarcely go.
name: Maturkan Warriors

requirements.detail: Can recruit Maturkan Warriors as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Uralic Metsänvartija can ambush invaders with a hail of arrows before melting back into the trees.
name: Metsänvartija

requirements.detail: Can recruit Metsänvartija as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Footmen have been the mainstay of Indian armies for centuries, and no weapon is as common as the simple bamboo bow which many Indian commoners practice through hunting from young age.
name: Paiks

flavor: A handful of men can hit the enemy with the force of a hundred archers with a single spark of flame, although it might be worth keeping an eye on the kind of men who would willing work with this sort of device.
name: Rocket Carts

flavor: These elite crossbowmen are armed with the mighty Shenbigong, the "Divine Arm Bow". Each bolt loosed can punch through armor and formations with unnerving accuracy.
name: Shenbigong

flavor: Warriors in the front present an impenetrable wall of shields to protect archers in the rear. This tactic deters skirmishers while allowing a steady advance.
name: Vigmen

requirements.detail: Can recruit Vigmen as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor:
Retinue Men-at-Arms
Feared across the Middle East and North Africa, the world boasts scarce-few such skilled camelry.
name: Retinue Camel Riders

flavor: Better suited to desert warfare than traditional cavalry, these riders dominate the sands.
name: Camel Riders

flavor:
Retinue Men-at-Arms
From towering howdahs, these beasts' skilled mahouts prove the only thing harder to stop than a charging elephant is another, larger elephant.
name: Retinue War Elephants

flavor: A charging elephant is alarming enough, but a charging elephant equipped with a powerful ballista on its back is sure to unnerve even the most battle-hardened foes.
name: Ballista Elephants

flavor: A charging elephant is almost impossible to stop, making them excellent shock troops.
name: War Elephants

flavor:
Retinue Men-at-Arms
Steadily advancing through the gunpowder smoke, these highly drilled handgunners can shatter the enemy ranks with their master-crafted guns.
name: Retinue Handgunners

flavor:
Using experimental formulas, men armed with strange polearms are able to rain fire down upon terrified enemies.
Enabled by the Powder Storehouse.
name: Fire Lancers

requirements.detail: Can recruit Fire Lancers as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor:
Expensive and explosive in equal measure, these crude firearms are incredibly effective weapons.
Enabled by the Powder Storehouse.
name: Handgunners

requirements.detail: Can recruit Handgunners as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

Retinue Men-at-Arms
Coursing into the fray with thunderous clamor and true nobility, the serried ranks of these horsemen inspire a terrible awe on any battlefield.
name: Retinue Lancers

flavor: Heavily armed and armored, these horsemen dominate warfare in the open plains.
name: Armored Horsemen

name: Sarawit

These famed axe-wielding Germanic mercenaries are the unwavering core of the imperial host.

 They will claim some Gold after the Basileus's death.

flavor:
Retinue Men-at-Arms
Atop swift steeds, these elite horsemen can outrun any foe and strike always where least expected and least welcome.
name: Retinue Outriders

flavor: Fast-riding and clever in their use of harsh terrain, yet clad in solid armor, these fierce nobles can serve as both harassing cavalry and a formidable vanguard.
name: Ayrudzi

requirements.detail: Can recruit Ayrudzi as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Unlike most cavalry, Iberian Caballeros are at home both on flat plains and in rough hilly terrain.
name: Caballeros

flavor: Outremer knights have mastered both European horsemenship and Levantine desert tactics.
name: Chasseurs

flavor: Fast and agile, Celtic Hobelars can easily raid the forests and hills other cavalry avoid.
name: Hobelars

flavor: Masters of raiding, the infamous Konni light cavalry of Eastern Europe can make short work of a fleeing enemy army.
name: Konni

requirements.detail: Can recruit Konni as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Light and swift, these horsemen are excellent at flanking, and devastating when pursuing routing enemies.
name: Light Horsemen

flavor: Scum of the earth, these men have forsaken lawfulness for a life of crime.
name: Marauders

flavor: These riders have honed their skills during a lifetime in close connection with the desert and cover their faces with the Litham veil, protecting them from the sand and from recognition by the enemy.
name: Mulathamūn

requirements.detail: Can recruit Mulathamūn as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Sahel Riders are mounted warriors who use light quilted armor and javelins to devastate their enemies
name: Sahel Horsemen

flavor: Though outfitted as scouts, these outriders rarely hesitate to charge isolated enemies and wreak swift violence on the unwary.
name: Steppe Raiders

flavor: This flexible cavalry force combines sword, spear and bow to defend their mountainous homelands from outsiders.
name: Tawashi

requirements.detail: Can recruit Tawashi as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

requirements.detail: Can recruit Tawashi as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Sworn by ancient oaths, these Brythonic horsemen ride as their lord’s loyal spear and shield.
name: Teulu

flavor: Born on a saddle, Horde Riders are trained from birth to ride into battle.
name: Horde Riders

flavor: Ready to fight for their land and dignity. Pushed to the brink of desperation, they will target any noble landlord to take what's due.
name: Pikemen Militia

flavor:
Retinue Men-at-Arms
Bedecked in fine armor and bearing long pikes, these infantrymen form the unbreakable core of their liege's army.
name: Retinue Pikemen

flavor: The Bondí are part of a class of free landholders, often competent sailors, that use longships to trade or to go viking. They fight using spears and shields.
name: Bondí

requirements.detail: Can recruit Bondí as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: German Landsknechts can use their massive zweihanders to tear through the massed ranks of enemy spearmen.
name: Landsknechts

flavor: Scum of the earth, these men have forsaken lawfulness for a life of crime.
name: Looters

flavor: The mobile formations used by Latin Picchieri make them more deadly than traditional pikemen.
name: Picchieri

flavor: Long pikes allow these regiments to form walls of spikes that can stop a cavalry charge dead.
name: Pikemen

flavor: The incredible discipline of Scottish pikemen lets them easily break enemy charges, even on open plains.
name: Schiltron

flavor: The tall skouton shields these infantry array against the foe is their namesake. Yet their chief virtue in battle is discipline, which affords them good order in both advance and retreat.
name: Skoutatoi

requirements.detail: Can recruit Skoutatoi as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Defending the faithful and serving their patrons, these monks' lives of devotion give plentiful time for training, and strong convictions.
name: Warrior Monks

requirements.detail: Can recruit Warrior Monks as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: These Daylamite warriors are a highly flexible force, equally able to form strong shield walls and fan out and hurl their short spears at the enemy.
name: Zupin Spearmen

requirements.name: Cultural tradition

requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: Large crossbows mounted on a wheeled platform that can launch steel-tipped bolts to impressive distances.
name: Siege Crossbows

name: Bombards

requirements.detail: Can recruit Handgunners as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

name: Fire Dragon Engines

requirements.name: Cultural tradition

flavor: A hinged folding ladder with a simple pulling mechanism to unfold once within reach of the enemy walls.
name: Cloud Ladders

flavor: The traction-powered mangonel is easier to operate than the onager while also boasting a faster rate-of-fire.
name: Mangonels

flavor: These small torsion catapults can tear down enemy fortifications by hurling stone projectiles over a distance.
name: Onagers

flavor: A large wooden tower on wheels that can be pushed up to enemy walls, offering more protection and stability than siege ladders.
name: Mobile Towers

flavor: On the boundless steppe, there's no need for siege towers or catapults — just a blazing torch and a swift horse, enough to set every yurt aflame.
name: Torch-Bearers

flavor: The counterweight trebuchet can hurl large projectiles with much greater force than mangonels or onagers.
name: Trebuchets

flavor: The Abudrar mountaineers know every gorge and wadi of their homeland.
name: Abudrar

requirements.detail: Can recruit Abudrar as Men-at-Arms
requirements.name: Cultural tradition

Retinue Men-at-Arms

name: Retinue Skirmishers

name: Akritai

name: Vaulter Infantry

name: Guinean Uplanders

name: Jomsviking Pirates

name: Light Footmen

flavor: Scum of the earth, these men have forsaken lawfulness for a life of crime.
name: Bandits

flavor: Although they are often armed with a kris, a golok, or a myriad array of other melee weapons, silat practitioners are equally well-versed in unarmed combat.
name: Pesilat Warriors
